title: Give every plan a place.
brief: A fictional personal-planning concept, with no promised financial result.
headline:
Give every plan
a place.
scene: Warm blush seamless background. A large lavender matte-clay envelope with a tiny friendly face holds three simple blank terracotta discs; one sage clay arch frames the envelope at right. A pale yellow rounded notebook lies low in foreground. Deep aubergine bold sans headline left. Quiet soft material texture; no currency symbols, numeric returns or financial charts.
